subject: Important Announcement: Upcoming Office Closure
body: Dear Team, I hope this message finds you well. We would like to inform you that our office will be closed for renovations from Monday, November 15th to Friday, November 19th. During this period, all employees are required to work remotely. Please ensure you have access to all necessary files and tools. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your cooperation. If you have any questions, please reach out to the HR department. Thank you for your understanding. Best regards, [Your Name]
